defect: AuroraPIC incremented particle-history age before testing for a prior synchronized observation, so energetic electrons in the first measurement timestep were counted as interstep promotions.
native_status: The native instrumentation tested age before incrementing it and did not have this defect.
reason: The first measurement is deterministically assigned to phase bin 0, whereas the prospective analyzer selects only phase bins whose centers lie in [0.125, 0.5).
